title: [finding] AGENTS.md states the merge queue's required set as six contexts and calls the rest advisory — it is seven, and no gate reds on the stale sentence
body:
Filed **unassigned and ungraded** by the `os-dev` seat implementing #15233 (branch `claude/issue-15233-required-contexts-seventh-row`). `domain:*`, `priority:` and type deliberately unset — triage's call. Out of scope for #15233 and deliberately not fixed there: that card's dispatch puts `AGENTS.md` explicitly off-limits.

## What AGENTS.md says

`AGENTS.md`, the merge-queue paragraph (lines 505-510):

> And **the queue enforces only the required set** — six contexts block: `Lint & Repo Gates` (all `check:*` gates), `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Build Core` and `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`. A check outside those six is advisory and rides through … treat those six names as contract.

## What the live ruleset says

`NODE_OPTIONS=--use-env-proxy node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --verify-required-set`, run 2026-09-12 against the live ruleset (`main`, id 12119582, active), exit 0:

```
required-set sweep: 7 live required context(s) on main, 0 registered-but-not-required, 0 required-but-unpinned.
    required: TypeScript Type Check
    required: Test Core
    required: Dogfood Regression Gate
    required: Build Core
    required: Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)
    required: Lint & Repo Gates
    required: Governed Surface Queue Guard
```

**Seven**, not six. The seventh is `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, enrolled in Settings on 2026-08-27 per #12427 (closed `completed` 2026-08-27T07:51Z on the maintainer's confirmation).

## Why this is worth a card, not a nit

The false half is not the number, it is the sentence that follows it: **"A check outside those six is advisory and rides through."** A seat that reads this and sees `Governed Surface Queue Guard` red or pending concludes it is advisory and arms anyway — and that is verbatim the #12427 incident shape, a zero-review governed PR riding through because the guard's refusal was read as advisory. The paragraph is operative prose a review seat acts on, not description.

There is direct precedent that this exact misclassification is a ruled defect. The #9677 ruling (2026-08-18) widened this same surface from two names to six for the same reason, recorded in `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`:

> the sentence had named two and called the other four advisory-and-rides-through, which is the misclassification that puts a PR into the queue to be ejected.

⇒ The set has since grown by one and the sentence has not followed.

## ⚠️ No gate reds on this — the same trap #15233 is itself an instance of

`AGENTS.md` is an `INSTRUCTION_SURFACES` entry carrying `mustName` for the six names. **`mustName` does not require exclusivity**, so:

- adding the seventh `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` row (what #15233 lands) does **not** red this surface;
- the six names it does list are all still real, so the scan stays green;
- nothing anywhere counts the surface's names against the registry's length.

⇒ ⛔ "Every gate is green" is not a reading that this paragraph is right. #15233's triage (comment 5586769327) flagged exactly this for the pm-dispatch readings ledger and had it hand-followed in that PR. **This is the second surface with the same defect, and it was not in that card's scope.**

## Suggested remedy (not a ruling — the lane's to make)

Either hand-follow the sentence six → seven the way #15233 hand-followed the readings ledger, **or** decide that `mustName` growing is what should have reddened here and make exclusivity checkable, so the next enrolment cannot leave this sentence behind a third time.

## Dedup

Scanned all 137 open issues carrying `tooling` or `domain:devx` (73 + 125, deduped; `domain:devx` paged to exhaustion — page 3 empty) for `agents.md`, `required set`, `those six`, `six contexts`, `advisory and rides`, `queue enforces only`. Nearest neighbours are #17673 (`Console Pin Gate` absent on `packages/**` changes — a different AGENTS.md rule and a different instrument) and #16696 (docs-drift row precision). **No open twin.** Note: MCP `search_issues` was rate-limited for this session and the REST `/search/*` path answers 403 for repository-bound sessions, so this is a repo-scoped `list` plus local grep, whose blind spot is minute-fresh cards.
